label: WriteChannelEnvelopeIfChanged
claim: A with low three bits 0 gets bit 3; a changed value is written to register base + $12, hSndFreqHi to base + $14 and the length bits of base + $11 are cleared

label: WriteChannelEnvelopeIfChanged
claim: an unchanged value (B = A | 8 = $F8) writes nothing (Z set)

label: WriteChannelEnvelopeIfChanged
claim: A with low bits set is written as it is (channel 2, base 5)

label: WriteChannelRegisterC
claim: writes A to $FF00 + wSoundRegBase + C; B = A

label: ClearChannelLengthBits
claim: [$FF00 + wSoundRegBase + $11] &= $C0

label: ReturnTwiceIfSoundSkipMaskAAndSoundSkipMaskB
claim: wSoundSkipMaskA & wSoundSkipMaskB = 0: returns normally with A = 0 and Z set

label: ReturnTwiceIfSoundSkipMaskAAndSoundSkipMaskB
claim: a non-zero AND pops the return address into AF and returns to the next address on the stack

label: SoundLabelSlot
claim: HL = wSoundLabelSlots + channel * 12 + (B & $0F) * 3 (channel 2, B = $13)

label: SoundLabelSlot
claim: the sum carries into H (channel 5, B = $0F gives $DD29)

label: CheckSlotStatusBlock
claim: a present slot with none of the tested status bits: carry clear, A kept

label: CheckSlotStatusBlock
claim: status byte 8 bit 3 sets carry

label: CheckSlotStatusBlock
claim: byte 0 & $D0 (BSTAT0_CONFUSED) sets carry

label: CheckSlotStatusBlock
claim: an absent slot sets carry without reading its status

label: CheckSlotStatusBlock
claim: byte 3 & $3F (BSTAT3_VACANT) sets carry

label: CheckSlotStatusBlock
claim: byte 5 & $C0 (BSTAT5_IRONIZED) sets carry

label: CarryUnlessBattleSlotOutSlotEmpty
claim: wBattleSlotOut[A] = 0: carry clear; A, BC, HL kept

label: CarryUnlessBattleSlotOutSlotEmpty
claim: a non-zero byte ($01, and $FF) sets carry

label: CarryUnlessBattleSlotOutSlotEmpty
claim: A of 8 or more sets carry without reading the table

label: CompareHLToBC
claim: Z set when HL = BC

label: CompareHLToBC
claim: carry set when HL < BC (high bytes differ)

label: CompareHLToBC
claim: HL > BC with equal high bytes: Z and carry clear

label: CompareHLToBCFastZero
claim: BC = HL = 0: A = 0, Z set, carry clear

label: CompareHLToBCFastZero
claim: BC = 0, HL non-zero: Z and carry clear

label: CompareHLToBCFastZero
claim: HL = 0 < BC: A = 1, carry set, Z clear

label: RandomInRange
claim: DE = HL + R mod (BC - HL + 1) with R = wRandomHi:wRandomLo after AdvanceRandom (min 10, max 16: 4220 mod 7); HL ends as the negated minimum, BC as R mod the range

label: RandomInRange
claim: minimum 0: DE = random mod (BC + 1)

label: RandomInRange
claim: HL = BC: DE = HL and the random state is not advanced

label: AdvanceRandom
claim: outside link play (wLinkMode = 0): wRandomHi = (wRandomHi + 1) & $7F, wRandomLo = RandomByteTable[wRandomHi]

label: AdvanceRandom
claim: in link play the step runs on wRandomSeed2Lo/Hi and both copies end with the new value

label: NextTableByteSecondStream
claim: NextTableByte on the wRandomSeed2Lo/Hi state; wRandomLo/Hi and the seed copy both hold the result; HL kept

label: DivideHLByBC
claim: B non-zero: HL = HL / BC, BC = HL mod BC (1000 / 300)

label: DivideHLByBC
claim: B = 0 goes through DivideHLByA (1000 / 7 = 142 r 6)

label: AddAx9ToHL
claim: HL += A * 9; DE kept

label: AddAx9ToHL
claim: the product wraps in 8 bits ($1D * 9 = $105 adds 5)

label: AddAx9ToHL
claim: the addition carries into H

label: BattlerRecordFieldAddress
claim: slot 2: HL = wBattlerRecords + 2 * $4E + E

label: BattlerRecordFieldAddress
claim: slot 4 uses record 3

label: BattlerRecordFieldAddress
claim: slot 3 shares record 2 with slot 2

label: QueuedActionMatches
claim: Z when A is the queued action; A and BC kept

label: QueuedActionMatches
claim: Z when A is the other id of the pair (SKILL_PANICALL_AD against SKILL_PANICALL); A is then the partner id

label: QueuedActionMatches
claim: NZ for a pair id whose partner is not queued (SKILL_IRONIZE against $AD); A is left as the partner id $AE

label: DebugStaffRoll_Init
claim: wMusicRequest = $31 and the 56 bytes at wWorkBuf are cleared (the byte after them is not)
